title: Conditional kappa .00310915222: distributed scalar updates
body:
A read from owned centre 747 is replaced by four scalar updates at two other contacts. Field 715 is not read between those contacts. Their exact source-functional sum restores it before the next read, so its H1 and H2 transports merge into one H3. Every independent target and centre query remains paid.

The complete conditional saving is **κ = 0.00310915222**, up **0.00000043910** (**0.01412482%**) over [PR5684](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/5684) at `d0f6fa2555410a1e23fe4191424c2097ab3d5d97`. The whole invoice changes by `-18 H1 -18 H2 +18 H3`, with no target change: **66,348 paid calls, 12,958 targets**. The raw crossing is strictly in `(0.00310915224562, 0.00310915224563)`. This is a new distributed-update construction with a small gain; it does not deliver the requested large breakthrough.

The package contains the [exact temporal proof](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/a5348f7143f95fe0046b92b96172e30763c7d731/research/p104-temporal-updates/PROOF.md), full chronological word, source pins, [native, caller and complete price receipts](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/a5348f7143f95fe0046b92b96172e30763c7d731/research/p104-temporal-updates/RESULT.json), and open next questions. Publication head: `a5348f7143f95fe0046b92b96172e30763c7d731`. It changes only `research/p104-temporal-updates/`. It does not combine pending PR decimals or change the selected frontier.

```sh
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/p104-temporal-updates
```

Validation covers all **565,504** public/owned endpoint coefficients in rational and dense transpose replays, **2,917** native maps including absolute phase, the actual physical caller, two exact moment engines, completion/rounding/tail guards, the finite compiler threshold and all **54 strict plus 4 functional outer checks**. Nine semantic controls reject altered source signs, a missing update, a read across the claimed interval, false frames, an unpaid query, an extra target and omitted native/owned operations. A damaged frozen source rejects before import. Normal and optimized registered replay passed. All 21 committed package files passed the byte checks and official export checks. A read-only optimized Git-free replay passed with an empty PATH; all 22 export files, including the manifest, kept their exact bytes and modes. The sealed scientific commit `c1ec999229213f052e899d89e2e3dd696ceb33ef` is an ancestor of the publication head; only PROOF.md and VALIDATION.md changed afterward. [Validation details](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/a5348f7143f95fe0046b92b96172e30763c7d731/research/p104-temporal-updates/VALIDATION.md) separate author checks from hosted CI and independent review.

The five inherited native, owned-erasure, compiler, precision/tape and analytic/recovery assumptions remain. The huge uniform word and complete rounded multiplier are not materialized. All eight H7 centre queries remain; this deletes one recipient contact, not a centre query. No independent human or proof-kernel acceptance is claimed. Full-history ancestry preflight is unavailable in the shallow checkout.
